A machine builder needs six vacuum cups with different suction levels for irregular parts. They buy BP-1P-0006 and install flow restrictors on each outlet. The result: when one cup seals against a flat surface, back-pressure rises and the other cups lose suction — parts drop. Rule: BP-1P-0006 is a distribution manifold, not a pressure regulator. All six outlets share the same inlet pressure. For independent channel control, use BP-2P-0001 or BP-3P-0004 with separate inlet passages.

A machine builder needs three different air pressures for clamp, blow-off, and vacuum on a rotary table. They buy BP-2P-0002 and install regulators on each outlet. The problem: outlet 3 shares an inlet with outlet 1 or 2, so when the clamp line pressurizes, the blow-off line pressure fluctuates. The result is inconsistent part handling and dropped workpieces. Rule: BP-2P-0002 has 2 inlets feeding 3 outlets. For three truly independent pressure zones, use BP-3P-0007 (3-in-3-out) with separate inlet control for each passage.

A machine designer needs 4 independent functions on a rotary table and assumes "4 outlets means 4 independent channels." BP-2P-95-0001 is a 2-in-4-out distributor: 2 inlets split to 4 outlets, not 4 independent inlets. Rule: Confirm the internal channel arrangement before connecting different pressure sources; specify a true 4-in-4-out design when four independent circuits are required.

Secure the flange using 4×M5 screws with spring washers. Torque to 3–4 N·m. Overtightening beyond 5 N·m warps the aluminum flange face, creating a gap that lets the body rock under hose load. Secure the flange using 4×M5 screws with spring washers. Torque to 3–4 N·m. Overtightening beyond 5 N·m warps the aluminum flange face, reducing the seal housing clearance and causing binding between passages. Because BP-8P-0001 has 8 closely spaced seals, even 0.1 mm of flange warp can cause inter-passage leakage. Tighten in a cross pattern (1-3-2-4) to distribute pressure evenly. Secure the flange using 8×M5 and 2×M10 screws with spring washers. Torque M5 to 3–4 N·m and M10 to 12–15 N·m.
